section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the factor structure analysis of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) using confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) and principal component analysis (PCA) on a single study with multiple analytical phases. The initial CFA on the full sample (N=591) did not fit well, so the sample was randomly split into two subsamples (n=296 and n=295) for PCA exploration and subsequent CFA confirmation. The final model identified a two-factor structure ('General Body Appreciation' and 'Body Image Investment') with adequate fit. Multi-group analyses tested invariance of this two-factor model across Malay (n=315) and Chinese (n=276) ethnic groups, confirming that the model structure was invariant across these groups.
